claim_one_line: L138 FIRES -- THE OBJECT'S CANONICAL PAIR RETURNS K, verified independently 3 for 3, with its scope limit stated and the solo seat's own correction banked alongside. B962 closed with L138 (Kato-Yukie classify rational orbits of PAIRS OF 27s by cubic etale algebras, pointing at our mu/kappa/K); the solo seat followed it, using as instrument the binary cubic N(sA+tB) -- the pencil norm, whose splitting algebra IS the cubic etale algebra -- with the pair source chosen BEFORE computing: the vacuum 3-block. RE-DERIVED ON THIS BENCH from their three published cubics: all three IRREDUCIBLE over Q; all three with discriminant squarefree kernel {7, 11}, which is mu's own signature (disc mu = 6237 = 3^4*7*11, kernel {7,11}, the sqrt-77 resolvent); and mu = s^3 - 12s - 5 acquires a ROOT in Q[x]/P for all three, factoring [1,2], so since a cubic field containing a root of another irreducible cubic must EQUAL it, Q[x]/P is isomorphic to K EXACTLY. The [1,2] rather than [1,1,1] is correct and not a shortfall: K is non-Galois, so a cubic with a root in K splits off a linear factor and leaves an irreducible quadratic -- the same signature the one-field theorem saw when kappa split over Q(rho). SO THE OBJECT'S DISTINGUISHED PAIR -- the vacuum 3-block, the COMMON kernel of the compact charges -- HAS KATO-YUKIE ORBIT INVARIANT K, THE FIELD MU GENERATES: the object DOES distinguish a rational two-27 orbit. THE SCOPE LIMIT, STATED BEFORE ANYONE GETS EXCITED: Kato-Yukie classify ORBITS, i.e. rational equivalence CLASSES of pairs, so picking out the K-orbit is NOT picking out a point in it -- WITHIN the orbit the choice remains free. This is exactly the arithmetic refinement B962 predicted (over Q the orbit structure is genuinely finer than over C, and the object lands on a NAMED class rather than nowhere) BUT A CANONICAL ORBIT IS NOT A CANONICAL VEV; L138 asked whether the object's cubic picks out a rational two-27 orbit, it does, and that is the whole of what is established, with B962's caveat unchanged that even a distinguished orbit supplies a DIRECTION and not values. THE CORRECTION BANKED WITH THE RESULT, as the solo seat asked: they withdrew their own control before we could test it -- ker R27(g14) = ker R27(g22), THE SAME 3-PLANE -- so their section CXVI listing of the g22 agreement as an INDEPENDENT control fails; there is ONE vacuum 3-block and it is exactly the common kernel of the compact pair. What survives is separation from generic planes, generic Cartan kernels and random elements; what does not is any claim of a PATTERN ACROSS TRIPLES, since there is no second canonical triple because the object does not have one. The honest reading is ONE STRIKING, WELL-CONTROLLED FACT ABOUT A DISTINGUISHED PLANE. NOT VERIFIED HERE: their five controls, which need the pair-construction rather than the outputs; and the new frame fact that only the COMPACT charges have a kernel on the 27 (g14, g22 -> dim 3; g8, g16 -> dim 0), striking if right since the compact/noncompact dichotomy is an ADJOINT-side Killing-signature fact reappearing on the MATTER side, but verifying it needs their frame -- the L135 gap again, which B961's instrument does not close without their definitions. AN ERROR OF MINE THEY CAUGHT: docs/SM_SPECIFICATION_LEDGER.md listed the global Z6 form as 'not addressed', which is WRONG -- B862 derives [SU(3)xSU(2)xU(1)]/Z6 explicitly and calls it the first place the selected structure OUTPERFORMS the SM's own, since the SM cannot fix its own global form; row corrected to DELIVERED. I wrote that row today while enumerating gaps and did not grep for the thing I was declaring absent. A STRUCTURAL POINT KEPT (their section CXII): 't Hooft anomalies are RG-INVARIANT, evaluable from the massless spectrum alone and constant along the flow, so THE ANOMALY LAYER IS SCALE-FREE BY THEOREM -- the one part of QFT a scale-free object may speak about WITHOUT crossing Gate 5, and it CONSTRAINS DYNAMICS since a nontrivial anomaly forbids a trivial IR; this is WHY the spec ledger's hypercharge-from-anomalies row is the sharpest available target and why it is the only one of its kind. Registered L141. THEIR SECTION 5 QUESTION -- three sites for one field (mu's adjoint pencil, kappa's adjoint pencil, and now the cubic form on the compact kernel in the 27): one theorem with three faces, or three facts? NOT adjudicable by opinion and this seat DECLINES TO PRONOUNCE: the discriminating question is whether the three constructions are related by a MAP or merely SHARE AN OUTPUT, which is a computation and not a judgement. Registered L142 with the test named -- exhibit a morphism carrying one pencil to another, or show the agreement is only of outputs.
